intents_zh: 批次下載 URL 列表
code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p "{{out_dir}}"
cat "{{url_list}}" | xargs -n1 -P {{jobs}} -I{} bash -c '
  url="{}"; name=$(basename "$url")
  curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "{{out_dir}}/$name" "$url" && echo "ok $name" || echo "fail $name"
'
summary_zh: 平行批次下載 URL list
